snippet.title: Starbrew Station | Official Trailer | Free-to-Play Idle Management Sim
snippet.description:
Wishlist Starbrew Station on Steam today! (It's FREE!)
➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4089330/Starbrew_Station/?utm_source=youtube

Take command of your own bustling interstellar hub in Starbrew Station, a free-to-play idle management game where deep strategy meets endless personalization. Manage five distinct decks, purchase 31 unique units, and design your station your way.

Launching November 14, 2025!

---------------------------------------------------

KEY FEATURES:
* Build & Manage: Oversee 5 unique station decks, from trade floors to research labs.
* Deep Progression: Purchase and upgrade 31 different units to optimize your station's economy.
* Endless Strategy: Reset your progress to unlock over 40 powerful prestige upgrades that fundamentally change how you play.
* Make It Yours: Customize your station's look and feel with a wide array of decorations.
* Completely Free: Starbrew Station is a free-to-play title on Steam.

---------------------------------------------------

About Lost Rabbit Digital:
Lost Rabbit Digital is an indie game studio founded by two brothers with a passion for creating unique and engaging experiences. Starbrew Station is their latest project.

Find us at: https://lostrabbit.digital

#indiegame #simulationgame #idlegame #managementgame #freetoplay
